title: Unit quiz
subject: Arabic
unit: Spring 1: Common vocabulary: numbers, colours, clothes and shapes
source: Seeded from arabic/y7 lesson 16 (Unit quiz (portal quiz or printable))
intro: Covers lessons 1 to 16 of Common vocabulary: numbers, colours, clothes and shapes. Answer every question. For multiple choice, fill in one circle.

questions.q: The reply to صَبَاحُ الخَيْرِ is:
questions.a: B) صَبَاحُ النُّورِ. Morning greeting, morning reply: صَبَاحُ النُّورِ (morning of light).

questions.q: What is ١٧?
questions.a: A) سَبْعَةَ عَشَرَ. ١٧ is seven-ten: سَبْعَةَ عَشَرَ.

questions.q: Which letter never joins to the next letter?
questions.a: B) ر. ر is one of the six: ا د ذ ر ز و.

questions.q: How do we read رَبّ?
questions.a: B) rabb. Fathah on ر gives ra; the shaddah on ب doubles it: rabb.

questions.q: Which is Thursday?
questions.a: B) الخَمِيس. الخَمِيس comes from خَمْسَة, five: the fifth day.

questions.q: Which is correct for 'I have four books'?
questions.a: B) عِنْدِي أَرْبَعَةُ كُتُبٍ. After 3 to 10 the noun is plural: كُتُبٍ.

questions.q: The feminine of أَخْضَر is:
questions.a: B) خَضْرَاء. أَفْعَل → فَعْلَاء: خ ض ر gives خَضْرَاء.

questions.q: Which is correct for 'this is a green book'?
questions.a: B) هٰذَا كِتَابٌ أَخْضَرُ. كِتَاب is masculine: هٰذَا and أَخْضَرُ, colour after the noun.

questions.q: What does أَلْبَسُ مِعْطَفًا mean?
questions.a: A) I wear a coat. أَلْبَسُ = I wear; مِعْطَفًا = a coat.

questions.q: Which is correct?
questions.a: A) أَلْبَسُ قَمِيصًا أَبْيَضَ. Object with -an, colour after it in the object form without tanwin.

questions.q: Bismillah. How do we read كُتُب? A) kataba B) kutub
questions.a: B) kutub

questions.q: Which letter makes a long 'ii'? A) ا B) و C) ي
questions.a: C) ي

questions.q: Bismillah. Which is Friday? A) الجُمُعَة B) الخَمِيس
questions.a: A) الجُمُعَة

questions.q: What is عِشْرُونَ? A) 12 B) 20 C) 10
Bismillah. How many letters are in the Arabic alphabet? A) 26 B) 28 C) 30
How many forms can one Arabic letter have? A) 2 B) 4 C) 6
questions.a: B) 4 (alone, start, middle, end)

questions.q: Bismillah. Which letter does NOT join forward? A) د B) س C) ل
questions.a: A) د

questions.q: Which mark means 'no vowel'? A) fathah B) sukun C) kasrah
questions.a: B) sukun

questions.q: Bismillah. Reply to صَبَاحُ الخَيْرِ. A) صَبَاحُ النُّورِ B) مَسَاءُ النُّورِ
questions.a: A) صَبَاحُ النُّورِ

questions.q: What is يَنَايِر? A) January B) June C) July
questions.a: A) January
